taxonomic_note: Accepted by current Kew/POWO. A distinctive Texas-to-Mexico woody-based Penstemon specialized on dry limestone cliffs and crevices.
look_here_first: Start with the woody base and leaf texture. Rock penstemon is a low densely branched subshrub with thick dark-green leathery leaves that have coarse mucronate teeth. It grows from limestone cracks and carries red tubular flowers on short stalks.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Val Verde County — Devils River/Amistad regional vegetation studies document Penstemon baccharifolius on limestone cliff and canyon-wall fissures. Edwards County — University of Colorado herbarium specimen 01667633 was collected about 18 miles north of Carta Valley on Hwy 377 toward Rocksprings. Bandera County — NPSOT Hill Country field account documents P. baccharifolius blooming on a limestone canyon wall in Bandera County and describes its range from Bandera/Medina westward.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Nursery-grown rock penstemon is common in xeric landscapes; county decisions rely on wild field/herbarium evidence.

best_field_traits: densely branched with lower stems becoming woody
leaves small, thick, leathery and dark green
leaf margins coarsely serrate, teeth often mucronate
corolla red to rosy red, roughly 25–30 mm, tubular/bilabiate
white inner throat heavily marked with dark guide lines
specialized for dry limestone crevices, bluffs and canyon walls
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Penstemon triflorus: P. triflorus is herbaceous rather than woody-based and has thinner, larger opposite leaves. Penstemon cobaea: P. cobaea is a broad-leaved herb with enormous pale flowers, not a woody cliff subshrub. Penstemon tenuis: P. tenuis is a slender wet-site herb with tiny lavender flowers and soft thin leaves.

comparisons.key_distinctions: P. triflorus is herbaceous rather than woody-based and has thinner, larger opposite leaves. P. cobaea is a broad-leaved herb with enormous pale flowers, not a woody cliff subshrub. P. tenuis is a slender wet-site herb with tiny lavender flowers and soft thin leaves.
